idea-plugin.name: Agent Refs [Beta]
idea-plugin.description:
English

Agent Refs [Beta] copies precise code references from the IntelliJ IDEA editor to the clipboard, so you can paste them straight into a coding agent without manually typing file paths or line numbers.

  • Select code and click the copy icon in the floating code toolbar; double-clicking a method or variable behaves exactly like a manual selection.
  • Copy from the editor context menu using Copy as Code Reference, placed right above Copy / Paste Special, or with Ctrl+Shift+C.
  • Every reference carries the project-relative file path and the exact line range, such as @src\Example.java#L10-12.
  • When nothing is selected, the current file reference is copied without line numbers.
  • References go to the clipboard only, so they work with any agent or chat window.

Platform support: copying code references works on every platform, including Linux.

中文

Agent Refs [Beta] 用于在 IntelliJ IDEA 里把选中的代码复制成准确的代码引用， 直接粘贴给编码 Agent，无需手动拼写文件路径和行号。

  • 用鼠标选中代码后，点击浮动工具栏里的复制图标；双击方法或变量与手动选中代码的行为完全一致。
  • 通过编辑器右键菜单中的 Copy as Code Reference（位于 Copy / Paste Special 上方）或快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+C 复制。
  • 每条引用都带上项目相对路径和准确的行号范围，例如 @src\Example.java#L10-12。
  • 未选中代码时复制当前文件引用，不带行号。
  • 引用只会复制到剪贴板，因此适用于任意 Agent 或聊天输入框。

平台支持：复制代码引用在所有平台都可以使用，包括 Linux。
